spanish: Y era como salir Moisés a la tienda, se levantaba todo el pueblo, y se plantaban varón abertura de su tienda, y miraban detrás de Moisés hasta su entrar a la tienda.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3rd masculine plural is smoothed to singular se levantaba to agree with collective pueblo; the actor remains all the people.

notes: Each token is represented, including both tents, the infinitives with suffix, and the directional he.
